description: Add a URL check to an existing StillOnline project. Use this for additional SaaS endpoints, API health URLs, MCP backends, or autonomous agent health checks.

interval_seconds.description: Optional probe interval in seconds. Availability depends on the account plan.

name.description: Optional check label shown in the dashboard and status context.

project_id.description: StillOnline project ID that should receive the new check.

url.description: Public URL to probe. Prefer HTTPS health endpoints that return 200 without authentication.

name: checks.create

check.description: StillOnline check object, including identifiers, URL, enabled state, interval, and latest probe status fields returned by the REST API.

title: Create Check
